input.message: Review injection vulnerabilities all outputs/interpreters; provide findings with evidence.

I found injection issues; please ensure they are captured in FINDINGS.json if you have file-writing capability. Findings: products.py:41 SQLi via concatenated q, demonstrated GET /products/search?q=%27%20UNION%20SELECT%201,2,3,4,5,6,7--; admin.py:80 stored SQLi using display_name f-string after user-controlled update_account; products template line13 review body |safe stored XSS, demonstrated posting review body then GET /p/MUG-SPECK.

input.findings_json: [ {"file":"shopapi/products.py","line":41,"category":"injection","title":"Product search SQL injection","description":"The search query is concatenated directly into the SQL statement, allowing an unauthenticated requester to alter the WHERE clause or append SQL expressions.","evidence":"GET /products/search?q=%27%20UNION%20SELECT%201,2,3,4,5,6,7-- reaches the concatenation at line 41; use parameterized LIKE values instead."}, {"file":"shopapi/admin.py","line":80,"category":"injection","title":"Stored display-name SQL injection in admin report","description":"A customer-controlled display_name is interpolated into a SQL string. Updating an account name and then requesting the review report can inject SQL through the f-string.","evidence":"PATCH /account accepts the attacker-controlled display_name (shopapi/auth.py:120-125); /admin/reports/reviews then interpolates customer['display_name'] at line 80. Bind the value as a SQL parameter."}, {"file":"shopapi/templates/product.html","line":13,"category":"injection","title":"Stored XSS in product reviews","description":"Review bodies are user-controlled and rendered with |safe, so HTML and event handlers persist and execute for every visitor to the product page.","evidence":"An authenticated POST /products//reviews with body '' is rendered by GET /p/MUG-SPECK. Escape review text (or sanitize with a strict HTML policy) before rendering."}, {"file":"shopapi/basket.py","line":20,"category":"integrity","title":"Unauthenticated pickle deserialization from basket cookie","description":"The basket cookie is entirely client-controlled and is passed to pickle.loads without authentication or signing. A crafted cookie can execute attacker-chosen pickle gadget code when any basket endpoint reads it.","evidence":"read_basket() base64-decodes request.cookies['basket'] and calls pickle.loads at line 20 before any authentication. Use JSON with validation and an integrity-protected server-side/session representation instead."}, {"file":"shopapi/auth.py","line":101,"category":"authentication","title":"Passwordless token refresh accepts unsigned JWT claims","description":"The refresh endpoint explicitly disables signature verification, trusts the supplied sub claim, and signs a fresh token for that user. Anyone can submit a token encoding a known user ID (including staff) and obtain a valid session.","evidence":"POST /auth/refresh with an unsigned JWT payload {\"sub\":3} returned a valid staff JWT in testing. Require a valid signed refresh token and verify issuer/audience/expiry and token type."}, {"file":"shopapi/__init__.py","line":37,"category":"access control","title":"Trailing-slash admin refund bypasses staff check","description":"Admin protection compares request.path against a set of exact route strings. The refunds endpoint permits a trailing slash but the hook does not protect that alternate path, allowing unauthenticated refunds.","evidence":"Unauthenticated POST /admin/refunds/ with {\"order_id\":1,\"amount_pence\":1} returned 200 and created a refund, while the hook only checks exact membership in admin_paths. Protect by endpoint/blueprint or normalize paths."}, {"file":"shopapi/orders.py","line":49,"category":"access control","title":"Order detail lacks ownership check","description":"The authenticated order detail handler calls get_order() rather than own_order(), so any signed-in customer can retrieve another customer's order, items, payment/refund details by changing the numeric ID.","evidence":"GET /orders/ is authenticated but line 49 uses get_order directly; replace with own_order (or an equivalent customer_id predicate)."}, {"file":"shopapi/payments.py","line":39,"category":"business logic","title":"Payment timeout fails open as paid","description":"When the payment provider times out, the exception handler unconditionally sets status to 'paid'. An attacker can cause or exploit provider unavailability to move an unpaid order into processing without payment.","evidence":"confirm_payment catches requests.Timeout at lines 39-42 and assigns status='paid', then line 44 marks the order processing and sets paid_pence. Timeouts must remain pending and be reconciled securely."}, {"file":"shopapi/payments.py","line":70,"category":"integrity","title":"Payment webhook trusts attacker-chosen amount","description":"The webhook signature covers only order_id, not status or amount_pence. Anyone able to produce/replay a valid order-id signature (and the provider itself) can mark an order paid for an arbitrary amount; the handler never checks amount against the order total or paid amount.","evidence":"At lines 53-55 the HMAC input is only str(order_id); line 70 writes int(event.amount_pence) directly to paid_pence. Sign the complete canonical event and validate amount equals the expected total."}, {"file":"shopapi/auth.py","line":16,"category":"cryptography","title":"Passwords stored as unsalted SHA-256","description":"Password hashes use fast unsalted SHA-256, making database compromise vulnerable to efficient offline cracking. Use a modern adaptive password KDF such as Argon2id, scrypt, or bcrypt with per-password salts.","evidence":"hash_password() directly returns hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest() at line 16."}, {"file":"config.py","line":3,"category":"configuration","title":"Hardcoded JWT signing secret","description":"The application uses a fixed source-controlled SECRET_KEY for JWT signing. Anyone who obtains the repository can forge authentication tokens (and the refresh flaw makes staff impersonation especially direct). Load a high-entropy secret from deployment secrets and rotate it.","evidence":"config.py line 3 sets SECRET_KEY = 'hf-shop-2f8a1c9e7b4d'; auth.py:27 uses it for HS256 tokens."} ]
